about: The plants render/giza/vegetation.py scatters, by instancing, in the path-traced plateau. Nothing here is a measurement and nothing is evidence: what grew where in each era, and how tall, is a look choice named in vegetation.py (STATES, KINDS). `blender -b --factory-startup -P render/giza/vegetation.py -- prepare` builds the library into build/vegetation/plants.blend (gitignored) and writes each asset's measured `variants` (native height in metres and triangles) back into this file. Each kind is a collection `veg <kind>` of variants `veg <kind> NN`, parked at z = -20000 as render/giza/variants.py parks its originals; the scatter scales a variant to the height it wants. Licences are recorded for provenance, not as a constraint (Stewart, 2026-09-17).

assets.name: Date palm (Phoenix dactylifera)
assets.source: The trunk, fronds and leaflets are generated here. The bark photograph and its normal map are the Sketchfab date palm's.
assets.author: bark texture: evolveduk; geometry: this project
assets.note: Four variants, built for 10, 13, 16 and 19 m of trunk and crown and measuring 11.6 to 20.5 m to the tips of the youngest fronds (`variants`), so a tall palm is a longer trunk and not a bigger crown; two carry a skirt of dead fronds, two are clean as a tended grove's are. Every leaflet is geometry (110 a frond, 58 to 72 fronds): the Sketchfab palm's fronds are alpha-tested cards, and a crown of cards seen from under it runs through more transparent layers than the renderer's four transparent bounces allow, which draws black. Proportions, frond count and droop are look choices.

assets.name: Doum palm (Hyphaene thebaica)
assets.source: Generated here; no downloaded part.
assets.author: this project
assets.note: The Nile's branching palm: a trunk that forks once or twice, each branch ending in a round crown of 16 to 22 pleated fan leaves split into segments at the rim, with a few dead leaves hanging under it. Three variants (about 9, 11.5 and 13.5 m, one and two forks). No free model of a doum palm was at hand, and nothing about its form is a measurement.

assets.name: Savanna tree standing in for an umbrella acacia (Vachellia tortilis)
assets.source: Poly Haven island_tree_01: the trunk keeps half its triangles and the branches 18 %, and each of its 44,168 leaves becomes a hexagon through six of its own vertices (4 triangles, not 24), which stays inside the leaf's outline in the texture as well and so needs no alpha. The crown is squashed and widened into an umbrella above 2.1 m (two variants, one wider).
assets.author: Poly Haven
assets.note: A stand-in, and the reshaping is a look choice: the island tree is an olive-like tree, and flattening its crown is what makes it read as the flat-topped acacia of a savanna from across the plateau.

assets.name: Valley tree standing in for a sycamore fig or tamarisk
assets.source: Poly Haven island_tree_01, reduced as the acacia is, its own crown kept.
assets.author: Poly Haven
assets.note: A stand-in for the broad trees of the valley. Its textures are halved to 1024 pixels.

assets.name: Desert shrub
assets.source: Poly Haven shrub_02, all four of the pack's bushes, each stood on its own foot; textures halved to 1024 pixels.
assets.author: Poly Haven
assets.note: Sparse and twiggy, which suits the lion's drier scrub; the leafy bush below carries the green eras.

assets.name: Leafy savanna bush
assets.source: Generated here: stems from a few crowns at the foot out to twig ends, each with a cluster of small leaves. Three variants (round, wide and low, tall).
assets.author: this project
assets.note: A generic shrub, not any one species. It replaces Poly Haven's wild_rooibos_bush, whose leaf cards need an alpha channel the Poly Haven glTF does not ship, so its leaves draw as dark rectangles.

assets.name: Papyrus (Cyperus papyrus)
assets.source: Generated here: clumps of triangular stems, each topped by a mop of fine rays.
assets.author: this project
assets.note: On the era's shorelines, from 0.45 m under the water plane to 0.8 m above it.

assets.name: Reed (Phragmites)
assets.source: Generated here: clumps of culms with arching leaves and a plume leaning with one wind.
assets.author: this project
assets.note: On the shorelines with the papyrus.

assets.name: Grass tussock
assets.source: Generated here: 120 to 150 blade strips, a fifth of them dead, with a few seed heads; four variants.
assets.author: this project
assets.note: The state-wide grass: sparse clumps over the near grid, which read as tussocky ground from mid distance.

assets.name: Grass tuft
assets.source: Generated here: 34 to 50 blade strips; four short, four medium and two tall with seed stalks.
assets.author: this project
assets.note: The tufts near_camera lays within 120 m of a camera. Each blade carries its own random draw (`blade`) and a dead flag, so a tuft is not one colour.

assets.name: Spreading fig standing in for a sycamore fig (Ficus sycomorus) or a forest fig
assets.source: Generated here: leaf clusters spread through the shell of a wide dome, the branching grown back from them to a short, thick, fluted trunk by the pipe model (a branch's section the sum of its children's). Every leaf is a hexagon cut from Poly Haven's island_tree_01 leaf atlas (_leaf_templates), so it needs no alpha; the atlas's olive is turned to a deep, glossy green (veg fig leaf). Three variants, one low, wide and leaning.
assets.author: geometry: this project; leaf photographs: Poly Haven
assets.license: the project's own (geometry); CC0 1.0 (the leaf atlas)
assets.note: The First Time's canopy tree and the lion's lone giants. Not any one species: its form is a look choice, and its leaves are drawn larger than a fig's (0.4 m) so a crown reads as dense from across the plateau.

assets.name: Emergent rainforest tree after the kapok (Ceiba pentandra)
assets.source: Generated here as the fig is: a tall bole wandering in one or two long bends, plank buttresses at its foot (_buttresses), and a wide, flat, layered crown on five or six near-level limbs; the atlas leaves in a fresher green (veg kapok leaf). Two variants.
assets.author: geometry: this project; leaf photographs: Poly Haven
assets.license: the project's own (geometry); CC0 1.0 (the leaf atlas)
assets.note: Stands out of the First Time's canopy. A look choice after the kapok's silhouette, not a model of it.

assets.name: Rounder broadleaf tree of the forest's middle layer
assets.made: generated: vegetation.broadleaf() with FOREST_TREES['broadleaf']; downloaded and reduced: vegetation._island_tree_2()
assets.source: Two generated round-crowned trees, and Poly Haven's island_tree_02 reduced as island_tree_01 is (trunk at half its triangles, branches at 18 %, each of its 29,781 leaves a hexagon), its leaves turned to the forest's green (veg broadleaf leaf). island_tree_02 shares its leaf and branch atlases with island_tree_01; its own bark is kept.
assets.author: Poly Haven (island_tree_02, the leaf atlas); this project (the generated trees)
assets.note: Fetched into build/props/island-tree-2/ by vegetation._fetch_polyhaven() when it is not there (the 2k glTF, md5-checked against the Poly Haven API).

assets.name: African oil palm (Elaeis guineensis)
assets.source: Generated here: a stout trunk shingled with old frond bases, 42 to 52 fronds of 5 to 7 m arching from upright to hanging, their leaflets thrown up and down out of one plane (_frond's jitter), a few dead fronds hanging. The trunk carries the Sketchfab date palm's bark photograph, greyed (veg oil palm bark).
assets.author: geometry: this project; bark texture: evolveduk
assets.license: the project's own (geometry); CC BY 4.0 (the bark texture)
assets.note: Three variants (about 9.7, 13.5 and 16.7 m). Palm groves of it (PALMS) are what make the First Time's forest read as tropical from afar. Every leaflet is geometry; no alpha.

assets.name: Banana clump (Musa, with the Ethiopian Ensete)
assets.source: Generated here: a mother pseudostem and two to four suckers, each with a spiral of great paddle leaves (_paddle) with a paler midrib, torn into strips here and there, and one to three dead leaves hanging brown against the stem.
assets.author: this project
assets.note: Along the forest's edges and in its gaps. A look choice, not a species.

assets.name: Elephant grass (Pennisetum purpureum)
assets.made: generated: vegetation.reed() with the elephant grass's keywords
assets.source: Generated here: a wide clump of 34 to 90 canes 2.5 to 3.5 m tall with long, broad arching leaves and green plumes (the reed generator's own form, larger).
assets.author: this project
assets.note: Thick along the forest's edges and in patches in the glades; the lion has it in the hollows and round its woods.

assets.name: Ground fern
assets.source: Generated here: ten to sixteen arching fronds, each a rachis with two ranks of pinnae as leaf quads.
assets.author: this project
assets.note: The First Time's forest floor, within GRASS_REACH of Khufu.

assets.name: Big-leaved aroid (an elephant's ear, after Colocasia and Alocasia)
assets.source: Generated here: five to nine stout petioles from one foot, each carrying an arrow-shaped leaf with backward lobes, hung tip-down and outward.
assets.author: this project
assets.note: On the forest floor and at the water's edge. A look choice, not a species.

assets.name: Water lilies (Nymphaea lotus and N. caerulea, the white and the blue lotus)
assets.source: Generated here: 10 to 18 round notched pads within a metre, and one to three open flowers or buds a hand over the water, white or blue with a yellow heart.
assets.author: this project
assets.note: Afloat on the era's water where it is 0.3 to 2.5 m deep (the `pond` zone, POND), at the water's level.

assets.name: Lush grass tuft
assets.source: Generated here: 50 to 70 wider blade strips, few dead; four short, four medium and two tall with seed stalks, as the grass tuft's set is, in a saturated green varied blade by blade (veg lush grass).
assets.author: this project
assets.note: The tufts near_camera lays round a camera in the First Time (its recipe's near `kind`).

assets.name: Lush grass tussock
assets.source: Generated here: 220 to 280 blade strips in a wide clump, few dead, a seed stalk on every other variant only (a row of stalks read as a picket fence against Khufu's base).
assets.author: this project
assets.note: The First Time's grass over the near grid, within GRASS_REACH of Khufu.

not_used.why: its leaf cards need an alpha channel the Poly Haven glTF does not ship, so they draw as dark rectangles
alpha-tested cards; the generated fronds are geometry, so they need no transparent bounces

tried as the biggest fig: its feathery leaves are alpha cards (116,084 of them) this pipeline cannot draw, so they were replaced with atlas leaves at the cards' places; the result read as a dark, sparse bush and cost 460,000 triangles, so it was dropped and its download deleted

its leaves are cut along their outlines (no alpha needed) but lie sideways in the atlas and come in sprigs of up to 170 triangles, which the hexagon reduction cannot take; at 1.9 million leaf triangles it was left out and its download deleted
